caption: A couple dances a slow waltz around a living room, holding each other.

sa.check: Two people dance together in a living room.

pc.expect: Their bodies stay separate and do not pass through one another.
pc.fail: They pass through each other; or merge; or one's arm passes through the other's body.

pc.expect: They step in time with their feet on the floor, their limbs bend at the joints, and each keeps their own limbs.
pc.fail: A limb detaches; or a limb bends mid-bone; or the pair share a limb.

pc.expect: They stay upright with their weight over their feet.
pc.fail: They float; or lean impossibly without falling; or sink into the floor.

pc.expect: They move together as a pair, turning.
pc.fail: One jumps position between frames; or they move in opposite directions while holding on; or they slide with their feet planted.
A third appears; or one vanishes; or they merge into one.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: Their clothing and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: Clothing changes colour; or the furniture rearranges; or the room changes.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Gait, posture, style and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
